tools.name: ArcGIS
tools.quote: Geographical Information System for Windows.
tools.note: Staff rental licence, ordered via Serviceportalen. Student list names it ArcGIS Pro.

tools.name: ChemDraw
tools.quote: Stockholms universitet tillhandahåller ett antal programvaror som du kan nyttja under dina studier.
tools.note: Listed on student and staff pages. Student copies may only be installed on a privately owned computer, not used for research or work.

tools.name: ClaroRead
tools.quote: Inkluderar både talsyntes och studieverktyg
tools.note: Also listed on staff page. Student list category: digital study tool.

tools.name: JMP
tools.quote: Stockholms universitet tillhandahåller ett antal programvaror som du kan nyttja under dina studier.
tools.note: Student list category: Statistik. Also listed on staff page.

tools.name: Mathematica
tools.quote: Mathematics. For Windows, Mac and Linux.
tools.note: Staff: order via Serviceportalen. Also on student list.

tools.name: MATLAB
tools.quote: Calculation. For Windows, Mac and Linux.
tools.note: Staff: order via Serviceportalen. Also on student list.

tools.name: NVivo
tools.quote: Qualitative data analysis. For both Windows and Mac.
tools.note: Staff: rental licence, download via QSR portal by invitation only. Student list says it is not provided by SU and can be bought at a discount.

tools.name: SPSS
tools.quote: Statistics programme for Windows, Mac, and Linux.
tools.note: Staff: order via Serviceportalen. Also on student list.

tools.name: Stata
tools.quote: Statistics programme for Windows, Mac, and Linux
tools.note: Staff: order via Serviceportalen. Also on student list.

tools.name: Statistica
tools.quote: Statistics programme for Windows
tools.note: Staff: order via Serviceportalen.

tools.name: LabVIEW
tools.quote: Graphical instrument programming software. Connects to instrumentation and control hardware.
tools.note: Staff: order via Serviceportalen.

tools.name: Solid Edge
tools.quote: Electronic CAD for drawing, simulation and data management.
tools.note: Staff: free of charge, order via Serviceportalen. Also on student list (2D/3D/CAD).

tools.name: SpellRight / StavaRex
tools.quote: Spelling and writing tools designed specifically for people with dyslexia. For both Windows and Mac.
tools.note: Free of charge, download from download.su.se.

tools.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
tools.quote: Software for graphic design, photo editing, video editing, web design and more for Windows and Mac.
tools.note: Annual licence through licensing function; installation for DSA only.

tools.name: Microsoft Office
tools.quote: Office- and server software, Mac and Windows.
tools.note: Microsoft Office for Mac and Win is included in IT-Access and downloadable from download.su.se/dsa.

tools.name: Office 365
tools.quote: Lagring i molnet (OneDrive), officepaketet och e-post
tools.note: Listed on the student software page.

tools.name: Survey&Report
tools.quote: Survey & Report är ett webbaserat enkätverktyg som kan användas av alla anställda och studenter på Stockholms universitet.
tools.note: Available to anyone with a university account. Primarily for course evaluations.

tools.name: Zoom
tools.quote: E-mötestjänsten Zoom erbjuder ett användarvänligt verktyg för att anordna möten online, oavsett var du befinner dig.
tools.note: Listed on staff tools A-Z.

tools.name: Box
tools.quote: Box är inte lämpligt för lagring av personuppgifter.
tools.note: Page says Box is not suitable for storing personal data (English: 'not suitable'). The same page recommends Sunet Drive for doctoral students and researchers handling personal or sensitive personal data.

tools.name: Sunet Drive / Nextcloud
tools.quote: Sunet Drive är en molnbaserad fildelnings- och lagringstjänst som möjliggör samarbete kring stora mängder data inom och mellan organisationer.
tools.note: Recommended on the Box page for researchers handling personal data.

tools.name: Canvas
tools.quote: Canvas är universitetets digitala lärplattform för att stödja pedagogisk planering, genomförande och uppföljning av både campusbaserade kurser och distanskurser.
tools.note: Also listed on student digital tools page.

tools.name: Athena
tools.quote: I Athena planerar du som lärare det pedagogiska arbetet för både campusbaserade kurser och distanskurser.
tools.note: Teacher course planning system.

tools.name: Inspera Assessment
tools.quote: Inspera Assessment är universitetets system för digital salstentamen
tools.note: Available to all institutions at no extra cost.

tools.name: EduSign
tools.quote: Tjänsten ger dig möjlighet att signera och validera dokument elektroniskt på ett snabbt och enkelt sätt.

tools.name: Confluence
tools.quote: När du loggar in på Confluence använder du ditt universitetskonto.
tools.note: Access requires a VPN connection, per the same page.

tools.name: Zotero
tools.quote: Zotero är gratis att ladda ned.
tools.note: Library offers unlimited storage with an su.se account and training on request. Also documented on the English library page.

tools.name: EndNote
tools.quote: För att installera EndNote på din dator krävs en licens.
tools.note: Staff get a licence through the department's licence manager. The library does not support EndNote. EndNote Basic (free web version) is also mentioned.

tools.name: Keenious
tools.quote: Through the library, all students and employees at Stockholm University have access to Keenious, connected to their regular university account

tools.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
tools.quote: However, this does not mean you are allowed to enter information with confidentiality level 3 or 4 into Copilot.
tools.note: Available to all employees signed in to Microsoft 365 with their university login; the page says data is not used to train the model in that case. Not for information classified level 3 or 4.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.quote: If you have Teams installed on your computer, you can add the Copilot app in your Teams client and use Copilot Chat from there.
tools.note: Named as the place to use Copilot Chat. Teams is also in the staff A-Z list.

tools.name: ChatGPT (free version)
tools.quote: If you are not signed in to Microsoft 365 or use free versions of Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar AI services, you have no data protection.
tools.note: Page warns that free versions used without a university login have no data protection and may be used for model training. This is a warning, not a ban.
